svg.title: Attackers breaching an office wall as defenders hold behind cover
svg.desc: Original Breachline voxel cover: a cutaway office and lab room, a ragged hole blown through a partition with amber light and debris pouring in, a blue-banded attacker stepping through, orange-banded defenders behind an overturned desk and a barricade, and the uplink glowing on a table.
